name: fynk
description:
Your CRM knows the deal. Your project tool knows the work. Neither can turn it into a contract, so someone opens a third tab and retypes what the other two already know.

fynk closes that gap. Claude takes the details from the conversation you're already in, drafts the agreement from a template you've already approved, and sends it out for a legally binding signature. No third tab.

It works on the contracts you've already signed, too. Ask what you committed to on delivery times and clauses, see which agreements renew before March, retag forty contracts in one go, and works in whatever language they were written in.

Claude operates inside your own fynk permissions: it can only reach what you can, and nothing goes out without your confirmation.

Built for the people who handle contracts alongside five other things, with no legal team down the hall.

_published_faq.name: How do I add fynk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add fynk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.fynk.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the fynk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: fynk lists 56 MCP tools, including archive-document, attach-account-users-to-team, create-account-tag, create-account-team, create-document-from-pdf-upload, create-document-from-scratch, create-document-from-template, create-document-party, create-document-pdf-upload-url, create-document-signatory, create-template-dynamic-field, and create-template-party.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to fynk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to fynk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
fynk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
fynk is developed by fynk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
